column2: v. 維持，支持（判決、決定）
column3: The manager decided to uphold the company rule about late arrivals. (經理決定維持公司關於遲到的規定。)
She works in the financial sector and travels often for business. (她在金融領域工作，經常因公出差。)
Learning a new computer program was a big challenge for him. (學習一套新的電腦程式對他來說是一大挑戰。)
The two partners settled their lawsuit before going to court. (兩位合夥人在上法庭之前解決了他們的訴訟。)
We need to find a new supplier for office paper. (我們需要為辦公用紙尋找新的供應商。)

column2: n. 使用權限，存取途徑
column3: Do you have access to the building after six in the evening? (晚上六點之後你有進入大樓的權限嗎？)
The jury took only two hours to convict the thief. (陪審團只花了兩個小時就判定小偷有罪。)
Please contact our office if you need any further information. (如果您需要進一步的資訊，請聯絡我們的辦公室。)
He felt guilty about leaving the dinner party so early. (他因為這麼早就離開晚宴而感到內疚。)
I need to cancel my hotel reservation for next weekend. (我需要取消下週末的飯店預訂。)
Every passenger must fasten their seatbelt before the car moves. (每位乘客在車子開動前都必須繫好安全帶。)
It is critical that you finish this report before Friday afternoon. (你在週五下午之前完成這份報告是極其關鍵的。)
The team manager tried to rally the workers to meet the deadline. (團隊經理試圖召集員工一同趕上截止日期。)
Our company just bought products from our main rival in town. (我們公司剛向城裡的主要競爭對手購買了產品。)
He has been a strong supporter of the local soccer team for years. (多年來他一直是這支當地足球隊的堅定支持者。)
